videoPrinciples: HyperFrames CSS/UX is the primary visual system.
Use typography, whitespace, gradients, cards, masks, lines, diagrams and motion before imagery.
Use zero images when a scene is stronger without one.
Never use a generated image as a complete advertisement layout.
Never bake headlines, CTA text or Bavaria UI into generated imagery.
Prefer reusable approved assets before generating a new image.
